name: A Codex turn gets the same small cheer
case: Codex runs the tests, which pass, and finishes its turn three minutes in. Boop treats it as it would Claude's: a small pleased or happy face played as a success or a reply, never a cross or sad one, though Codex never says a turn failed.
why: The view lines Codex's hooks as Claude's (agent-hooks' Mapping.codex); PERSONALITY's Examples: a turn done gets a small face and its finish
